name: Car Industry
description: Automakers and major parts, tyre and aftermarket employers, including Korean, European, Japanese, American and Chinese companies. All role families are requested; regional boards and bounded sources are explicitly labelled. Includes UAP/NAPA Canada. Separate country/subsidiary systems and access-restricted boards remain coverage gaps. FreeHire discovery membership is planned separately; this collection contains validated native monitors only.
